answer: Proposal: gate reward seats behind proof-of-spacetime. At epoch's dawn each seat seals its assigned bytes — a slow serial transform — and posts the root; the chain spot-checks without warning, a lantern flash: return random sectors within seconds. Slow sealing makes holding hot bytes cheaper than recomputing them. Bytes differ per seat, each an opal with no twin, so N masks must hold N×D concurrently; rent scales per head and a mask pays off only if its expected reward clears its rent. Assume the seal resists shortcuts. Seam: storage is cheap.
